needsReview.note: GET /nursing/nurses/:param answers 401 without a token, so a visitor sees the unavailable state; and no screen links to this page (the providers list rows are not links; the ids may differ).

The fake confirmation (timer, random reference, insurance estimate) is gone from the catalogue; the component is still in the repo and only components-next/diagnostics-hub-client.tsx (not imported by any page) uses it. Delete both.
The catalogue is public but the service page it links to asks for sign-in; a visitor is sent to the login page.
Reads the auth cookie itself and shows the empty state when there is none, instead of redirecting to login like the other screens.
The page knows REQUESTED to COMPLETED; the app and the insurance flow use NEW_REQUEST, IN_PROGRESS, WAITING_COPAY: the timeline shows no current step for those.
Posts no address coordinates and offers fixed daily times (09:00 to 17:00), not the nurse's availability; a card payment gets no payment intent after the booking (the app starts one).
booking.duration and service.duration are drawn as the server wrote them ('1 hour'), in English, in every language.
